tasks.title: Package the desktop app: installer + bridge server sidecar
tasks.description: tauri build with the bridge server bundled as a sidecar binary (or embedded Node), so Crystal ships as one installer.

tasks.title: Publish @crystal/sdk to npm
tasks.description: tsup builds + exports maps for core/client/ui/modes/sdk so external apps can embed Crystal without the monorepo.

tasks.title: Agent runs in isolated git worktrees
tasks.description: Give each agent run an optional worktree so parallel runs on the same repo never conflict; surface diffs back in the run view.

tasks.title: Git status decorations in the editor file tree
tasks.description: Color modified/untracked files using the bridge's git.status method.

tasks.title: Crystal v0.1: three modes, one night
tasks.description: Architecture diagrammer (react-flow, nesting + grouping), PM board with live Claude Code agent runs, Monaco editor with VS Code/IntelliJ/Vim keymaps, embeddable SDK, bridge server, Tauri shell. Verified end-to-end in a real browser with a real agent run.
